run_custom_env_training: run the APPO algorithm training on a custom Gym environment with a custom PyTorch encoder
create_custom_env: create a custom Gym environment with random image observations and discrete action space
register_custom_encoder: register a custom convolutional encoder network for processing 10x10 image observations
parse_custom_args: parse SampleFactory CLI arguments with custom environment parameters like num_actions and episode_len
override_default_params: override default SampleFactory parameters to set a custom encoder and hidden size for the environment
